description: Resolve a declarative blocktools Plan (JSON text) against a Context (JSON text: evm nonce, gas, max_fee_per_gas, priority_fee; utxo fee_rate) to UNSIGNED bytes: evm returns unsigned_tx (EIP-1559 hex), utxo returns a psbt with fee, vsize and outputs. The account family is not built here (family_not_built). Signs nothing; the user's wallet signs. Pure, offline computation (blocktools); nothing is fetched or stored. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).
name: build_plan_tx
title: Resolve a transaction Plan to unsigned bytes (dev tool)
